name: Ferenbach Dormitory — source-bounded rough exterior

material_review.status: bounded draft proxies from individually observed material family
material_review.upper: pale oak planks preserve a horizontal light tan cladding profile; actual siding substrate unknown
material_review.lower: bricks are a reddish masonry proxy; lower material product unresolved
material_review.roof: stone_brick cap states preserve source gray overlapping-unit silhouette; actual product unknown
material_review.glazing: light_gray_stained_glass_pane reflects pale sash and gray reflections

wall_plane_evidence: Dominant source edges bear approximately −12° and +78°. Straight inset planes avoid dragging roof-segmentation noise down the facade. Roof cap, roof backing, physical placement and exact roof footprint remain unchanged. Setbacks of 0.4–1.2 m behind noisy source eaves are rough interpretations, not a survey of facade position.

provisional_entrance.evidence: A courtyard-facing dormitory entrance is documented in the corroborative Dell portfolio and visible circulation surrounds this face; exact portal position is unresolved. This open draft threshold supplies a reviewable local seam, not a claimed recovered door.

uncertainties: Rough exterior draft; exact lower masonry and upper siding products are unverified.
All aperture dimensions and registration are interpreted from small aerial pixels; no hidden east/west room-window rows are invented.
Observed projecting west corner bay retains three tiers; pale thin sash divisions are approximated at two blocks/metre.
Chimney position and open pergola geometry are unresolved and omitted; measured roof retained without speculative roof appendages.
Provisional north courtyard doorway/apron is an explicit construction anchor, not source-verified door geometry.
Interior program and floors beyond entry are unfinished; no interior route certification.
